item.title: Understanding the Auto-Update Mechanisms of 8 Common macOS Apps
item.description: Given that many large enterprises now have well funded teams building agentic harnesses for vulnerability research, I, with my makeshift harness and 20$ Claude Pro subscription, am not able to find issues that are niche enough to not have been already found by the enterprise harnesses. This has been evidenced by the fact the last ~10 reports I submitted to programs of various sizes have all been closed as duplicate. Therefore, I decided to look at other things I can write about here.
